authorityRationale: Florida Board of Nursing's own official MOBILE Endorsement application form (DH-5102) — the actual document applicants submit, stating eligibility conditions directly (active unencumbered license in another jurisdiction, no disciplinary action within 5 years).
reliabilityRationale: Primary application-form document hosted directly by the board itself, originally identified during Phase 2B research and now formally registered (Phase 2B.4).
